required_capabilities: Create Door/Window Type (×2); Load Library Element Type (×2); Create Door (×2); Inspect Project (×1)
instruction: The room is a simple rectangle with four exterior walls already built; do not modify them. Place exactly two doors. On the top (north) wall: an M_Door-Double-Sliding, 1800 x 2100 mm, its left edge 3000 mm from the top-left corner, measured along the wall. On the right (east) wall: an 'M_Door-Exterior-Double-Full Glass-Wood_Clad', 1800 x 2100 mm, its edge nearest the top-right corner 2500 mm from that corner, measured along the wall; it is the building's escape door and must swing in the escape direction. Create no other doors or openings.

doors.label: double sliding door on the north wall
double door on the east wall
